newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Ex-Brazil presidents gang up against CVRD sale.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Brazil presidents gang up against CVRD sale.

text.p: Former Brazilian presidents Itamar Franco and Jose Sarney Tuesday joined forces to oppose the privatization of state mining group Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), officials said.

Congress officials said the two men -- the former Brazil's current ambassador to the Organization of American States and the latter president of the Senate -- would jointly present a manifesto later Tuesday against the CVRD sell-off.
The Correio Braziliense newspaper, which printed the manifesto in full, said the signatories of the document opposed the CVRD privatization on the grounds of national interests.
